summary: Reject overlapping or redundant allowed-path scopes in V2 work-unit contracts
instructions: Implement Issue #18. Harden schema-v1 authority minimization by rejecting overlapping or redundant allowed_paths scopes. Reject a directory scope together with any descendant directory or exact file it already authorizes, while keeping disjoint sibling scopes valid. Preserve exact-file versus trailing-slash directory semantics and all existing traversal, .git, bounds, route, duplicate-trigger, and artifact-verification behavior. Add focused tests and run the full allowlisted unit profile.
